rule: An unattended comparison cycle may not introduce a new image binary or external product-image dependency. If a future article requires new product photography, that requires a separate provenance record with source, licence/permission and exact-product identity before the image can enter an autonomous release bundle.
reason: The review medium's evidence contract is exact product identity and non-fabricated review data. Reusing controlled site visuals is safer than allowing an unattended writer to introduce an unverified product image.
